definition: Regarded as deserving hatred, condemnation or a curse.
author: Gaston Leroux
quote: To begin with, I gave up every idea of returning to the passage that had brought us to that accursed chamber.
example_sentence: The accursed printer jammed again five minutes before the deadline.
